pre_u4_baseline.description: Default-off with writer stitch + plane-MST available

post_u7_gate_relax.description: Via-aware transitions only, no tree executor

default_off_post_u4_deletions.description: Default-off, writer stitch + plane-MST deleted (U4 full)
default_off_post_u4_deletions.note: U4 deletions removed the legacy copper the 149 baseline relied on

tree_mode_u2_u7.description: Tree executor (U2 resilient + U7 writer wired), default-off in code, measured with flag override
tree_mode_u2_u7.unconnected_items: ~54 nets fail with 'no legal tree edge'
tree_mode_u2_u7.failing_nets_classification: power (PWR_RTN, +3V3, +15V, vcc), ground (DC_BUS_RTN), HV (+340V_BUS), and near-net interconnects — all congestion-limited, not single-edge-failure
tree_mode_u2_u7.u2_resilience_impact: No measurable improvement — failure mode is grid congestion, not solitary-edge failure

verdict: U2 resilience fix cannot close the gap alone. 54 nets need the classification called for in R8. Congestion-limited nets need zone/pour or re-planning; power/ground/HV nets need the plane-connected path that U4's stitch deletion removed.
